## Lead intake
POST /webhook/lead-intake, then:
1. Validate name, email, company, and message.
2. Drop the same email on the same UTC day. Seen keys live in workflow static data.
3. Score with the rules in Score Lead (base, company, keywords, support cap).
4. Append a row with the Google Sheets node.
5. Post a short Slack message.
Invalid payloads and duplicates reply on their own branches and write a log entry.
A failure on the sheet or Slack node follows the error output into Log Integration Error.

## Credentials
This file has no credential ids.
In the n8n UI, attach Google Sheets OAuth on Append Lead Row and a Slack credential on Post Lead Notification.
Replace REPLACE_WITH_SPREADSHEET_ID and the channel name lead-alerts.
The error output is only for integration failures. Validation and duplicates are normal branches.
